name: omp-console
description: Coding environment for running and steering Oh My Pi agents on your own VPS.

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:agent-protocol && npm run build:backend && npm run build:agent-host
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:agent-protocol && npm run typecheck -w @omp-console/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @omp-console/agent-protocol && npm run typecheck -w @omp-console/backend && npm run typecheck -w @omp-console/agent-host
scripts.test: npm run build:protocol && npm run test -w @omp-console/backend
scripts.test:agent-host: npm run build:agent-protocol && npm run test -w @omp-console/agent-host
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:agent-host
scripts.dev: npm run build:protocol && npm run dev -w @omp-console/backend
